purpose: Paired 175-task K=10 text-only frontier-ceiling evaluation over two sealed enrichment arms, pooling all four exact Qwen3.7-Max model identifiers under the supplied text-weight-equivalence premise
text_equivalence_premise: The user confirms the exact snapshots differ only in vision-language capability; this experiment is text-only. Exact requested and resolved model identities remain stratified in every journal and diagnostic.
paired_invariant: The exact same model/global-sample allocation, completion cap, tolerance, thinking budget, sampling policy, and sealed task sequence are applied to both enrichment arms.

invalid_policy_pilot_quarantine.reason: The older bulk runs sent max_tokens with thinking enabled. Provider usage demonstrated that reasoning and final-answer accounting did not obey the runner's assumed total-completion cap, so those candidates and outcomes are not comparable to the clean estimator.
invalid_policy_pilot_quarantine.preservation_policy: Preserve all journals and artifacts; never merge their candidates or outcomes into this primary estimator.

reporting.primary: Pooled pass@10 and compile@10 for each enrichment arm over only the four clean-v4 shards
required_diagnostics: Per-exact-model token usage and reasoning-token usage
Separate inventory of invalid-policy pilot artifacts
